[3WFNMIGQ]: 141
[CJPTU9FV]: 34. Studies at gSang phu for several years between 1134 and 1138. Studies of epistemology and shar chos (Madhyamaka?) and composition of commentaries on epistemological works
relations.support_notes:
Although Phag mo gru pa is frequently reported to have studied at gSang phu in modern literature, no Tibetan biographical narrative that supports this claim could be identified. It is likely that the information that Phag mo gru pa studied with Phya pa influenced this claim. The narratives connect this event with the time of Phag mo gru pa's studies at the seat of rGya dmar ba.
One source, however, mentions that he went to gSang phu to pay his respects to Phya pa after studying with him at the seat of rGya dmar ba (Pad ma dkar po's Chos 'byung bstan pa'i padma rgyas pa'i nyin byed, fol. 269a [https://sakyaresearch.org/etexts/128/pages/269]: rgya dmar pa'i sar gzhi phab | dbu tshad nyan | zhar chos pa dge bshes phya pa la zhus | de nas khong gi phyag phyir gsang phur phebs |).
